acceptanceCriteria: gitauth tests no longer use process env, run parallel, -race clean
gitnotes tests parallel where safe; before/after timing with load recorded
body: Lane test-speed-1021k (PR #1463, V1-2220) parallelized 84/99 cem/gitauth tests and most of cem/verify. The remaining 15 gitauth tests call t.Setenv (35.5 s serial) and could take env via arguments instead. gitnotes was not touched because #1459 edits it; parallelize it after that lands.
title: tests: cem/gitauth 15 t.Setenv tests (35.5 s) and gitnotes stay serial; move to argument-scoped env and parallelize gitnotes
